purpose: Retrospective screen of heavier-tailed chamber residual models for rare passage failures after member-eb-v1.2-decay180 was selected. This screen is descriptive/post-selection and cannot by itself change production probabilities.

candidateDefinitions.normal-v1: Existing historical-residual-v1 Normal residual with sigma derived from historical chamber YES MAE.
candidateDefinitions.normal-sigma-1.25x: Same Normal family with systematic sigma multiplied by 1.25.
candidateDefinitions.normal-sigma-1.5x: Same Normal family with systematic sigma multiplied by 1.5.
candidateDefinitions.laplace-mae: Zero-centered Laplace residual with scale equal to the same historical chamber YES MAE, preserving mean absolute residual while adding heavier tails.
candidateDefinitions.logistic-mae: Zero-centered logistic residual with scale MAE/(2 ln 2), preserving mean absolute residual while adding heavier tails.

frozenSelectionRule.selection: Among non-baseline candidates passing every guardrail, select lowest primary-slice overall passage Brier; tie-break by failed-event Brier, then candidate id.

guardrails.interpretation: Candidate family and thresholds were frozen after historical rare failures had already been examined. Any winner is eligible only for non-serving prospective validation or a separate reviewed evaluation; no direct production promotion is allowed.
